messages.content: The retry test fails on CI but passes locally. Can you take a look?
TestRetryBackoff sleeps in real time and races its 100ms deadline on slower CI runners. I'll inject a fake clock so every backoff step is deterministic.
Sounds good. Keep the public API unchanged.
Done. retry.New takes an optional Clock and still defaults to the wall clock. `go test -count=50 ./retry` passes in 0.4s.
Pushed fix/flaky-retry and opened a draft PR with the before/after CI timings.
